name: Aragon
notes: Aragon / AragonMono: match the official AragonLogoIcon component of the Aragon app (viewBox 0 0 32 32, silhouette IoU 0.994); the colour #3164FA is the app icon icon-512.png and primary-400 in Aragon's gov-ui-kit palette, accessed 2026-10-04
